title: Fuel — Centre Tank Boost Pumps — Installation of Coarse Mesh Inlet Screens
abstract: Replacement of the fine inlet screens on the centre tank boost pumps by a coarser mesh that passes tank build debris without blinding, ending the low-pressure warnings seen at high fuel flow.

sections.planning_reason: Nineteen aircraft from the first four production batches have reported centre tank boost pump low-pressure warnings at high fuel flow shortly after a centre tank refuel. Every pump removed on the strength of a warning was serviceable and every inlet screen was partly blinded with cured sealant fragments from the tank build. The condition does not appear on aircraft built with the revised tank sealing process, so this is a one-time clean-up of the early population rather than a fleet campaign.
sections.description: The 74 micron inlet screen on each centre tank boost pump is replaced by a 180 micron screen with a larger open area. The screen carrier is replaced, and the pump outlet heat exchanger is re-shimmed because the new carrier is 6 mm longer.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Defuel and drain the centre tank, then purge and gas-free it to the standard practice. Open the wing tank access panels in zones 531 and 591 and enter the tank with a second person in attendance. Remove the pump inlet actuator D2820111798703 and the screen carrier. Recover every fragment found in the screen and in the pump inlet and bag them for return to Aeralis. Install the coarse mesh screen and the new carrier. Re-shim the pump outlet heat exchanger D2820117029234 to the dimension given in the accomplishment instructions. Check the clearance between the carrier and the inlet manifold CIN652579-17. Repeat for the second pump. Close the tank, do the fuel system leak check and the boost pump operational test at high flow, and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00559 built before the revised tank sealing process, excluding two withdrawn aircraft. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00561 onward were built with the revised process and do not need this bulletin, whatever the age of the screen fitted.
sections.material_note: Kit K2820-1019-01 contains two screens, two carriers and the shim set and is available from stock. The recovered sealant fragments are returned to Aeralis in the bag supplied with the kit; the analysis feeds the tank sealing process review.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next occasion when the centre tank is opened for another task, or within 60 months after the date of this Service Bulletin.
